subject: Hillside Avenue Certificates of Appropriateness
overview: The CC Historical Commission met to review and approve certificates of appropriateness for properties at 21-20 (21 Pro Ev) and 20 Hillside Ave, and approved the June meeting minutes.

items.title: Certificate of Appropriateness for 21-20 (21 Pro Ev)
items.summary: Approved the modified certificate of appropriateness to construct a standalone accessory dwelling unit and carriage house garage at 21-20.

items.title: Certificate of Appropriateness for 20 Hillside Ave
items.summary: Approved the certificate of appropriateness for window replacement and exterior alterations at 20 Hillside Ave, with amendments to shingle over a deleted window location.

items.title: June Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Approved the June 18th meeting minutes and agreed to cancel the August meeting, scheduling the next meeting for September 10th.
